[SWS_CORE_01496] swap overload for Map
⌈
There shall be an overload
of the swap function within the namespace ara::core for arguments of type Map. Its
interface shall be equivalent to:
template <
typename K,
typename V,
typename C,
typename Allocator
>
void swap(Map<K, V, C, Allocator>& lhs, Map<K, V, C, Allocator>& rhs);
This function shall exchange the state of lhs with that of rhs.
⌋
